dialogue_texts: Who's the other troublemaker behind this fog?
If you thought Berenice was one and done, you appear to be heading toward another.
So she wasn't the final boss after all, huh? Fine by me.
The more there are, the more magic I get to blow away!
The absolute darkness will claim you long before you reach them.
When I first saw Fusana glohmed again...
I immediately escaped to the Hakurei Shrine as I didn't want to be infected.
Heh, smart move. Leave the cleanup to the professionals.
Let's head inside and blow this mystery wide open!
